name: economics-mod-dev
description: Type check, lint, syntax and ESM checks, unit tests and coverage for the Economics Civ VII mod. Not shipped.

scripts.check:syntax: for f in ui/*.js scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:esm
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run check && npm run test
scripts.release:gate: npm run verify && npm run coverage
